title: hordelymus caput-medusae subsp. asper
intro: Hordelymus caput-medusae subsp. asper, commonly known as Rough False Brome, is a type of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and pain, and aiding in digestion. The health benefits of Hordelymus caput-medusae subsp. asper are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which are derived from its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
